handoff: Cause is code, not data. game/planet_panel.gd show_planet() loops every commodity from main.gd _commodities() and always prints 'buy X, sell Y' by reading base_prices[c+'_buy'] and base_prices[c+'_sell']; _price() returns 'n/a' for a missing key. Each planet in planets.json defines exactly one key per commodity (abundant: <c>_buy; scarce: <c>_sell), so the other half is always n/a. abundant/scarce are filled and valid for all 3 planets and match gdd.md and balance.json. trade.gd price() returns -1 for missing keys, so it already treats a missing side as not tradable. Fix for gameplay-programmer: in show_planet, print only the keys that exist (e.g. 'Energy: buy 10' or 'Food: sell 26'), skipping missing ones instead of 'n/a'. I did not add keys: it would make a missing side tradable and alter economy without owner approval.
